missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing /v1/orders requests
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) during the window
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show every checkout failure paired with a 500 from order, while gateway /readyz stays 200.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order (db pool, redis, payment) is not established; only the order-side 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently caused by order returning 500 on /v1/orders within the same correlation IDs; gateway health endpoints remain 200. The specific fault inside order is not yet bounded, so the candidate is scoped to the observed order-side 500 propagation.
